definitions.gloss: taking measurements; measuring (for clothing or tailoring)
definitions.explanation: The act of measuring someone's body dimensions for clothing, tailoring, or fitting purposes. Can also refer to measuring objects for construction or other purposes.

examples.japanese: ⟦スーツ→スーツ：01367_suutsu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{採寸|さいすん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: I had my measurements taken for a suit.

examples.japanese: {採寸|さいすん}⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧お⟦{仕立|した}て→仕立てる：09525_shitateru⟧⟦いたします→いたす：01314_itasu⟧。
examples.english: We'll take your measurements and then tailor it for you.

examples.japanese: ⟦カーテン→カーテン：01342_kaaten⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{注文|ちゅうもん}する→注文する：21390_chuumon⟧⟦{前|まえ}→前：02255_mae⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧、⟦{窓|まど}→窓：02254_mado⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{採寸|さいすん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{忘|わす}れないで→忘れる：00474_wasureru⟧⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Don't forget to measure the windows before ordering curtains.

notes:
Most commonly used in clothing and tailoring contexts, but can also refer to measuring for furniture, curtains, or construction. Combines {採|さい} (to take/gather) and {寸|すん} (a unit of measurement).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {採寸|さいすん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to take measurements
- {採寸|さいすん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{行|い}く→行く：00119_iku⟧: to go for a fitting
- {採寸|さいすん}⟦{結果|けっか}→結果：02486_kekka⟧: measurement results
- ⟦{身体|しんたい}→身体：03330_shintai⟧{採寸|さいすん}: body measurements

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{計測|けいそく}→計測：14189_keisoku⟧: measurement — more technical/scientific, used for instruments and precise data
- ⟦{寸法|すんぽう}→寸法：04311_sunpou⟧: dimensions, measurements — refers to the actual numbers/sizes rather than the act of measuring
